# Byaan

> AI-powered data agent that learns your business, runs in your infrastructure, and gets more accurate over time.

## What is Byaan?

Byaan is a local-first data analysis tool that connects to databases and AI models while keeping data private. It runs as a desktop application on macOS.

## Key Features

- Multi-database support: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, SQLite, MSSQL, CSV, Excel, Parquet, JSON
- Bring Your Own AI Model: Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Groq, OpenRouter, xAI
- AI-powered natural language queries and dashboard generation
- Interactive dashboards with dynamic filters and charts
- Scheduled reports with cron-based automation
- MCP server for integration with Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients
- Custom skills system for reusable analysis patterns
- Read-only by design — safe on production databases
- Export as standalone HTML, shareable links, or PDFs

## Privacy

Data never leaves the user's machine. The desktop app runs entirely locally. Database credentials, queries, and results stay on the local computer. No cloud uploads, no external servers.

## Pricing

- Individual: Free forever (Mac desktop app with all features)
- Teams: Custom cloud deployment with collaboration features (contact hello@byaan.ai)
